title: Pig in the Mud
pages: The sun is hot, hot, hot! A pig is in the sun.
The pig can see the mud. Mud, mud, mud!
The pig can dig. Dig in the mud!
The pig can hop. Hop in the mud!
Mud on the pig! Fun, fun, fun!
The pig can nap. Such a big mud pig!

title: The Hen and Eggs
pages: A hen sat in the shed. She had ten eggs.
The hen sat on the eggs. Sit, hen, sit!
The hen sat and sat and sat.
Then tap, tap, tap! Pop, pop, pop!
A chick! The chick is wet.
The hen and the chick hug. Yes!

title: The Red Ship
pages: See the big red ship.
It can go in the sun.
The ship can dip and rock.
Dip and rock! It is so fun.
See the fish! The fish see us.
The red ship can nap. It was fun!

title: Rex and the Fish
pages: Rex is big. Rex is wet.
Rex can see a fish!
The fish can dip. Rex can hop.
Dip, fish! Hop, Rex!
Dip and hop. So much fun!
Rex can hug the fish. Yes!

title: Fox and Hen
pages: A fox sat in the sun. The fox had no fun.
The fox can see a hen. A hen!
The hen ran and ran. Run, hen, run!
Hush, hen! said the fox. I do not chomp hens.
The fox has a bun. It is for us!
The hen sat. We had fun. Big hug!

title: The Cat Nap
pages: The cat can nap. But not yet!
Nap on the mat? Not this cat.
Nap on a lap? Not this cat.
Nap in the sun? Yes, this cat!
The sun is hot. The cat sat.
Nap, cat, nap. Fun in the sun!

title: Bug in a Rug
pages: A bug is in the rug.
A big pup can dig.
Dig and dig and dig!
Pop! I see you!
The pup and bug hug.
Yes! Fun for us!

title: Jam On Ham
pages: I see jam. I see red jam!
Jam on ham. Yum yum!
Jam on a bun. Jam on an egg.
Jam on a pot. Jam on a pan.
Jam on you and me! So wet!
So much fun. Yum yum!

title: The Big Fish
pages: A big fish sat in a dish.
The big fish had a wish.
A wish for fun in the sun.
Then a kid ran to the fish.
The kid and fish had fun. Wet fun in the sun!
The big fish got the wish. Yes!

title: Fox and Sock
pages: Fox has a red sock. It is a fun sock.
The sock is on Fox. Hop, Fox, hop!
Fox can hop on a rock. Hop, Fox, hop!
The red sock got wet. Wet, wet, wet!
Is Fox sad? No, not Fox!
Hop, Fox, hop! Fox has so much fun.
